name: shortcuts
title: Shortcuts
description: Every shortcut from the Shortcuts app, its folder as the section: Enter runs it, cmd+Enter runs it with the clipboard as input, cmd+T with the input typed in the bar, cmd+O opens it in Shortcuts. The result shows in the HUD.
author: pal

store.tagline: Run any Apple Shortcut by name, folders as sections
features: Every shortcut from Shortcuts.app as an indexed row, so its name at the root finds it; the folder is the section and a keyword
Enter runs it; the panel hides and the HUD shows Done or the first line of the shortcut's output when it ends, however long it takes
cmd+Enter runs it with the newest clipboard text as its input; Run with input (cmd+t) takes the text typed in the bar (a form when picked without it)
cmd+O opens the shortcut in the Shortcuts app for editing, cmd+C copies its name
A global hotkey per shortcut through `[palettes.shortcuts.item_hotkeys]`, keyed by the shortcut's name
Listed through the `shortcuts` command line tool (macOS 12 and later), refreshed every five minutes and on cmd+r; on Linux one row says it is not available
